description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useProjectCostHistorySum' that fetches and computes the total project cost, preferring incremental cost updates, with fallback to legacy data. It manages state, formatting, and data fetching logic for project cost summaries.

methods.name: useProjectCostHistorySum
methods.description: A React hook that fetches and returns the summed project cost, formatted as USD, with loading and error states, and a refetch method.
